snippet.title: IN THIS HOUSE - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Back this project on Kickstarter: http://kck.st/3VBlHcn 

In This House is a horror-adventure video game for Nintendo Game Boy, Analogue Pocket and PC. It uses timeless four-color 8-bit graphics to tell a universal story about the struggle for one's identity within a family.

You play as Bianca, a young woman who is visiting her grandpa at the 5th anniversary of her parents' death. She doesn't feel welcomed by her family, which also includes her aunt Barbara, her uncle Julian and her cousins: Leo and Seb.

The meeting is cut by sudden information: a mutated rabies virus is spreading and soon infected walking corpses find their way to the house the family is staying in. If that wasn't enough, Bianca starts to see a ghost of a girl who is related to terrible secrets hidden by the family. Your task is to survive one terrifying night and uncover the truth about your loved ones.

In this House will be available on May 2025.
